title: Sum over an injective image of a finite set
statement: Let $M$ be a commutative additive monoid, let $l$ be a list of elements of type $\beta$ with no repetitions, and let $S$ be a finite set of elements of type $\alpha$. Suppose $g:\alpha\to\beta$ is injective, every element of $l$ is $g(x)$ for some $x\in S$, and the length of $l$ equals the cardinality of $S$. Then the sum of $F$ over $l$ equals the sum of $F(g(x))$ over $x\in S$, for any function $F:\beta\to M$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a list with no repetitions
